title: Agents
description: One row per agent version and model, from your organization's real runs. Each score is the share of runs solved on that capability's benchmarks (newest version of each, clean runs), with a 95% range over tasks. A score is ranked once it has {{runs}} runs over {{tasks}} tasks.
loadError: Could not load the agent leaderboard.
empty: No agent has finished runs yet. Run an evaluation to fill this board.
baselineHint: A ready-made agent from the Heimdall library
simulatedCustomerHint: A model played the customer ({{simulator}}). Ranked on its own, never mixed with scripted customers.
noVersionHint: This run was not started from an evaluation, so its agent version was not recorded.
notEnoughHint: Not ranked: {{runs}} runs over {{tasks}} tasks; ranking needs {{minRuns}} runs over {{minTasks}} tasks

why.includePracticeHint: Practice runs are the made-up example benchmarks. They are left out unless you tick this.
why.emptyFiltered: No runs of {{agent}} match these filters.

notMeasuredHint: No run of this agent used this capability's benchmarks, so it has no score.
rankAllHint: Place by the All score: the share solved over every capability with enough runs
tieHint: Its 95% range overlaps the row above, so the two are not clearly apart
scoreHint: Share of runs solved on this capability's benchmarks: higher is better
